title: The Iron Biscuit
subtitle: A Curious Case at Hindustan Park
summary: When an anxious bank cashier seeks Byomkesh Bakshi’s help with an unusual problem, the renowned detective’s curiosity is instantly piqued. In the quiet lanes of Calcutta, a seemingly trivial incident unravels into a web of intrigue. Dive into this riveting mystery where every detail may hold the key to the truth.
